name: homebridge-roborock-room-clean
description: A fan in Apple Home for every room on your Roborock map: turn it on to clean the room, the fan speed sets the suction power. Vacuum-only and number of passes configurable, with no 10-routine limit. Your Roborock app routines can be added as switches too, and show when they are started from the Roborock app. Optional: the robot itself with the vacuum icon (Matter), and a map camera with the robot's live map in a colour style you choose. Settings in English or Hebrew.
author: orenasher
